records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for setting up Timber Ventures on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged early: first project day 1, welcome call held (calendar:731f1e46), asked a product question (tick_0d1dc44c597a, email:7eb9bc08). But no invite sent 6 days in, Starter, solo usage, and no customer message since Jun 12 — key milestone within 8 days unaided is possible but not likely.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks again for flagging the search question last week — to confirm, search is exact-match only today; partial-word matching is on the roadmap. That ticket is now closed, so do say if anything there is still unclear.

Since you've got your first project in place, the natural next step is bringing the rest of Timber Ventures in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through that on a short call this week if it's easier — just name a time that suits you.

Best,
Chidi
